data.one_liner: Easy form state management and validation using the BLoC pattern.
data.what_it_does: Separates form state and business logic from the user interface. It provides built-in support for synchronous and asynchronous field validation, wizard/stepper forms, submission progress, and dynamic fields.
use_when: You are building complex forms with custom validation rules in Flutter.
You want to manage form state separately from UI widgets using the BLoC pattern.
avoid_when: You only need simple uncontrolled forms with basic text controllers.
You are not using the BLoC pattern or prefer simpler state management for forms.
strengths: Comprehensive feature set including async validation, wizard steps, and dynamic fields.
Separates business logic and validation nicely from the UI.
Built on top of the established bloc package.
weaknesses: Requires learning the form_bloc specific architecture.
Can be overly verbose for trivial form use cases.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding form_bloc to your pubspec and integrating it with your BLoC structure.
